sources.title: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) Certification Exam Objectives
sources.notes: Consulted for the domain names, the domain weightings, the 28 top-level objective identifiers, and the high-level scope/topic of each top-level objective, used to design the original Ducelio curriculum in package.json and as provenance metadata in objective-coverage.json. No official objective prose, sub-bullet text or exam questions were copied; every lesson, resource, practical activity, assignment and controlled-assessment question in this package is original Ducelio-authored instructional content.
